newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to up.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to up.

text.p: Early calls on CME live cattle futures ranged from 0.150 cent lower to 0.100 cent firmer while feeder cattle were called steady to 0.200 cent higher.

Most analysts anticipate carryover selling pressure in live cattle futures following Monday's reversal from early gains and a farily large setback. Light boxed beef movement and continued weak packer bids for fed cattle should weigh on the market, they said.
However, others look for support to develop on an oversold condition.

Feeder futures were also considered oversold after the sharp break Monday from new contract highs. Despite looking technically weak, bullish indications from the Cattle Inventory report continue to point to tighter feeder cattle supplies, they said.
A large increase in the latest CME feeder cattle index should also lend support and offset calls for higher corn futures, they added.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was up $0.60 at $70.05 per cwt.
